# 0.0.1: Stray Cat Strut (11-26-2026)

## Breaking changes

- tabby now requires Quarto 1.11 or later.

## Features

- Automatic creation of tabsets for code blocks

## Bug fixes

- `.tabby` blocks render on current Quarto releases.
